cond_0001.intro:
The Senior Programmatic Analyst owns strategic planning and campaign execution for an assigned client. This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
The Senior Programmatic Analyst must possess a strong inner drive to contribute.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Work with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Partner with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Work with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Strong project and time management skills
Preferred Requirements:
Strong negotiation skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team

cond_0181.intro:
The Senior Programmatic Analyst owns strategic planning and campaign execution for an assigned client. This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
The Senior Programmatic Analyst must possess a strong inner drive to contribute.
cond_0181.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Work with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Partner with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Work with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0181.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Strong project and time management skills
Preferred Requirements:
Strong negotiation skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team
cond_0181.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0181.values: We value creating work that has a meaningful and positive effect on others. We believe fairness, respect, and responsibility should guide how we operate.

This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
The Senior Programmatic Analyst must possess a strong inner drive to contribute.
cond_0233.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Lead coordination with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Drive inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies with programmatic buyer(s)
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Direct the creation of consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Manage feedback and needs with offshore management
Own process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Lead the Pioneer training program across office in partnership with the Manager
cond_0233.requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Strong negotiation skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Strong project and time management skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team

This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. A regular part of this role is training Programmatic Analysts on client-specific requirements, sharing expertise in optimization strategies, and staying in close contact with clients on best practices and communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
cond_0303.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Work closely with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Connect regularly with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Stay in ongoing contact with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0303.requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Strong negotiation skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Strong project and time management skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team

This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
Most people become stronger in programmatic work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0329.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Work with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Partner with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Work with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0329.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Preferred Requirements:
Strong negotiation skills
Strong project and time management skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team

We are looking for a Senior Programmatic Analyst to join our team.
The Senior Programmatic Analyst owns strategic planning and campaign execution for an assigned client. This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
The Senior Programmatic Analyst must possess a strong inner drive to contribute.

Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Partner with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Work with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0570.requirements:
Around 1–2 years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Familiarity with programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Willingness to develop and apply negotiation skills in a team setting
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Comfort with analytical thinking and mathematical problem-solving

Organizational skills and openness to managing projects and time with guidance

This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
The Senior Programmatic Analyst must possess a strong inner drive to contribute.
cond_0595.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Work with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Partner with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Work with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0595.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Strong project and time management skills
Preferred Requirements:
Strong negotiation skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team

This position is both strategic and tactical in scope, requiring the Senior Programmatic Analyst to independently generate strategic insights for the campaigns in their portfolio and implement campaigns with the support of Programmatic Analysts. This role will train Programmatic Analysts on client specific requirements, providing expertise in optimization strategies and guidance on best practices related to client communication.
The ideal candidate will have prior online trafficking and campaign management experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and prior experience with bid management platforms and active campaign optimization.
People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with programmatic planning and campaign management.
cond_0608.responsibilities:
Inventory & New Channel Strategy:
Meet with, vet inventory, and advance channel partners
Proactively identify opportunities to test partners and bring those ideas to programmatic planning counterparts
Create custom solutions including but not limited to: white lists, custom marketplaces, PMPs, SSPs, cross-channel, etc.
Work with platforms, SSPs, and programmatic buyers to ensure accurate implementation
Troubleshoot supply issues on all pre-production and live campaigns
Oversee supply and new channel QA process
Partner with programmatic buyer(s) on inventory performance analysis and optimization strategies
Identify case study potential for key opportunities and lead creation with programmatic buyer(s)
Develop best practices for inventory solutions/new channels and regularly communicate out to the larger programmatic team
Maintain log of all inventory and new channel testing across all [Company name masked] offices
Programmatic Operations:
Work with the Manager to create consistent processes across office for using offshore resources
Work with offshore management on feedback and needs
Maintain process docs, training, and new hire onboarding material across office
Partner with the Manager to coordinate Pioneer training program across office
cond_0608.requirements:
1-2 Years of experience working with RTB, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, verification partners and other supply platforms
Deep understanding of programmatic planning, buying, and ad tech vendors
Strong negotiation skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office solutions, specifically Excel
Strong analytical thinking and mathematical skills
Excellent communication and writing skills
Strong project and time management skills
Strong desire to contribute to a team
